name: The majority voted against an [amendment](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6886_amend_3f0d8363-9380-4fe1-a6bd-73a07cd54488%22;rec=0) introduced by the Jacqui Lambie Network and ACT Senator [David Pocock](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/act/david_pocock) (Independent), which means it failed.
